boot.crashBody: Lucid hit an unexpected error while drawing this page. Reloading usually fixes it; your calendars are safe on your server.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Connect to your CalDAV server. Lucid never stores your calendars.
login.serverHint: A domain like example.com is enough; Lucid finds the calendar service.
login.privacy: Your password is encrypted in the server-side session and is never sent to this browser again.

validation.serverRequired: Enter the address of your calendar server.
validation.serverInvalid: Enter a valid address, for example https://cloud.example.com.

errors.invalid_credentials: The server rejected this username or password.
errors.discovery_failed: No calendar service was found at this address. Check the URL or enter the full CalDAV address.
errors.forbidden_target: This server address is on a blocked network. Ask your administrator to allow it.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.rate_limited_retry_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
errors.rate_limited_retry_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
errors.upstream_error: Your calendar server didn't respond. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: Lucid can't reach its server. Check your connection.
errors.invalid_input: Some of the entered data is invalid.
errors.unsupported_component: This calendar doesn't accept this type of entry. Choose another calendar.
errors.series_move_unsupported: This series can't move like this. Move only this one instead.
errors.series_split_unsupported: This series can't be split. Change only this one or all instead.
errors.conflict: This item was changed elsewhere. Lucid reloaded the latest version.
errors.not_found: This item no longer exists. Lucid reloaded the calendar.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.repeatsLoadFailed: Some repeating tasks couldn't be loaded.

calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.empty: No calendars on this account yet.

agenda.empty_one: There are no events in the next day.
agenda.empty_other: There are no events in the next {{count}} days.

event.undoConflict: Couldn't undo: the event was changed elsewhere in the meantime.
event.dialogDescription: Title, time, calendar and details of the event.
event.title: Title
event.timezoneOther: Times are in {{tz}}. Saving moves the event from {{from}} to this time zone.
event.noWritableCalendar: None of your calendars accept new events.

dnd.instructions: Press space to pick it up. Use the arrow keys to move it, space or enter to drop it, escape to cancel.

event.move: This event repeats. Which events should move?
event.change: This event repeats. Which events should change?
event.delete: This event repeats. Which events should be deleted?
event.allRuleRemovedNote: Only this event stays. All others are deleted.

task.move: This task repeats. Which repeats should move?
task.change: This task repeats. Which repeats should change?
task.delete: This task repeats. Which repeats should be deleted?
task.thisNote: Becomes a task of its own. The series goes on {{next}}.
task.followingRuleRemovedNote: From {{date}} on, only this repeat stays. Earlier ones stay as they are.

scope.followingNote: From {{date}} on, as a series of its own. Earlier ones stay as they are.
scope.followingRuleRemovedNote: From {{date}} on, only this event stays. Earlier ones stay as they are.

missing.attendees: With attendees, the series can't be split.
missing.attendeesTask: With attendees, a repeat can't become a task of its own.
missing.taskThis: Only the current repeat can be changed on its own.

reason.fixedDays: The series stays on its days.

hint.eventAll: Applies to every event in the series.
hint.eventRuleRemoved: The series becomes this one event. All others are deleted.
hint.taskThis: Only this repeat. It becomes a task of its own.
hint.taskAll: Applies from this repeat on. Done ones stay.
hint.taskAllFromLater: Applies to all repeats, the current one too. Done ones stay.
hint.taskRuleRemoved: The task stops repeating. Upcoming repeats are removed.
hint.taskFollowing: This and following repeats, as a series of their own.

toast.followingMoved: Moved from {{date}} on, as a series of its own.
toast.followingChanged: Changed from {{date}} on, as a series of its own.
toast.detachedMoved: Moved to {{date}} as a task of its own. The series goes on {{next}}.
toast.detachedChanged: Changed as a task of its own. The series goes on {{next}}.

scope.undoneSeriesKept: Undone. The new series was changed in another app and stays.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.empty: No tasks in this list yet.
tasks.noCalendars: None of the visible calendars hold tasks.
tasks.editDescription: Title, start and due date, priority and checklist of the task.
tasks.newDescription: Title, list, start and due date of the new task.
tasks.confirmDeleteSeries: This task repeats. Delete all repeats? Completed ones stay.
tasks.deleteCompletedNote_one: It's removed from the server, and from other apps too.
tasks.deleteCompletedNote_other: They're removed from the server, and from other apps too.
tasks.ruleUnsupported: Lucid can't read this repeat. Complete and move it in the app that created it.
tasks.upcomingHint: Can be completed once {{date}} is done.
tasks.lastRepeat: Done. That was the last repeat.
tasks.undoConflict: Couldn't undo: the task was changed elsewhere in the meantime.
tasks.undoneCopyKept: Undone. The completed entry was changed in another app and stays.
tasks.undoneDetachedKept: Undone. The detached task was changed in another app and stays.
tasks.detachedNotice: Detached from its series. The series goes on {{next}}.
tasks.repeatInfoDone: When you complete a repeating task, the completed one stays as its own entry and the task moves on to its next repeat. That way other apps such as Apple Reminders or Tasks.org also see what is done.
tasks.repeatInfoOrder: Repeats are completed in order. Changing only one repeat makes it a task of its own, and the series goes on.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Shortcuts work whenever no dialog is open.

offline.label: Offline
offline.description: Lucid can't reach its server. Changes are paused and resume when the connection is back.

refresh.label: Refresh
refresh.offline: Lucid can't reach its server right now.
refresh.failed: Couldn't refresh. Try again in a moment.
refresh.failedShowing: Couldn't refresh. Showing what was loaded at {{time}}.

about.source: GitHub (source code, opens in a new tab)

validation.endBeforeStart: The end can't be before the start.
validation.tooManyItems: A checklist can hold at most 200 items.
validation.dateForTime: Choose a date for this time.
validation.startDueType: Give both dates a time, or neither.
validation.startAfterDue: The start can't be after the due date.
validation.repeatNeedsDate: A repeating task needs a date.
